items.title: 68163_Tom Whaley oral history interview
items.q: And see, Ethel Waters was one of my big stars, that you know, came under me -- Lena Horne.

ctx.x: had Willie Smith in there, and they had Louis -- a fellow named Louis on the trumpet, also. But I say that's the greatest band in the world.

So when Jimmy went to the Cotton Club right after Duke left, my man asked him if he had gotten anybody to arrange, so he said there was a boy downtown there at the Lafayette, and they called me up and I went up there and I arranged two numbers -- Here Goes a Fool in Love, and I'm Going To Love You as Long as I Live.
Lena Horne was the ingenue, and what's the boy -- oh, what's his name? Gates or Yates or something. He was in Brown Sugar.
